subtasks: Pour the liquid from the first red bottle into the first black bowl, from the second violet bottle into the second white bowl, and from the third turquoise bottle into the third brown bowl. Then reset the robot arm.
Pour the red bottle into the black bowl on the left, let the liquid settle, then return the red bottle upright.
Set the red bottle down upright and release it, then pour the violet bottle into the white bowl in the middle, let the liquid settle and return violet upright.
Release the upright violet bottle, then pick up the turquoise bottle lying on its side on the left. Pour it into the brown bowl on the right, let the liquid settle, then return turquoise upright.
Grasp the turquoise bottle body with the left gripper, lift it clear of the brown bowl, and tip its mouth down into the brown bowl until the liquid settles. Then return it upright.
